body: If the FPS stays the same on both backends, it doesn't seem to be a performance issue. It might just be that for Metal, the calculation for process time is including V-Sync time into account, giving misleading results.

I was able to repro this. Subsequent runs produce a random average measurements between 2-16ms each within about +/- 1ms of each other per run.

I looked into the cause and found this is a measurement artifact, not a performance issue, but is a bug nonetheless. Metal's [`layer.nextDrawable`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/drivers/metal/rendering_context_driver_metal.mm#L174) call blocks waiting for a drawable from the Metal layer's pool ([Apple docs confirm blocking behavior](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/quartzcore/cametallayer/1478172-nextdrawable)), and this blocking time is included in [`Performance.TIME_PROCESS`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/main/performance.cpp#L243-L244) measurement because the call chain flows:

* [measurement starts](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/main/main.cpp#L4893)
* [`RenderingServer::draw()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/main/main.cpp#L4923)
* [`draw_viewports()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/servers/rendering/renderer_viewport.cpp#L736)
* [`blit_render_targets_to_screen()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/servers/rendering/renderer_viewport.cpp#L947)
* [`screen_prepare_for_drawing()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/renderer_compositor_rd.cpp#L40)
* [`swap_chain_acquire_framebuffer()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp#L4395)
* [`acquire_next_frame_buffer()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/drivers/metal/rendering_device_driver_metal.mm#L1048)
* [`Surface::acquire_next_frame_buffer()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/drivers/metal/rendering_context_driver_metal.mm#L163-L179)
* [`nextDrawable` blocks here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/drivers/metal/rendering_context_driver_metal.mm#L174)
* [measurement ends](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/main/main.cpp#L4933)

The blocking duration depends on [vsync mode](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/drivers/metal/rendering_context_driver_metal.mm#L195-L199) and phase alignment. When the app starts, the [main loop begins](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/main/main.cpp#L4735) at a semi-random phase relative to the display's refresh cycle (anywhere from just-after-vsync to just-before-vsync), and the [first `nextDrawable` call](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/drivers/metal/rendering_context_driver_metal.mm#L174) determines whether it blocks for between ~2-16ms based on when a drawable becomes available. This phase stays consistent within each run but varies between runs, creating the "random lock-in" effect on each run.

Vulkan doesn't show this because it uses [asynchronous `vkQueueSubmit`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp#L2960) with [semaphore-based synchronization](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp#L2949-L2957) where the frame pacing occurs during [`vkQueuePresentKHR`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp#L3019) [after the `process_ticks` measurement completes](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/main/main.cpp#L4933), not during [swap chain acquisition](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp#L2622-L2628) which happens [inside the measurement window](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/main/main.cpp#L4913-L4929) for Metal.

Possible fixes:
1. Move the [timing measurement end point](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/main/main.cpp#L4933) to [before `RenderingServer::draw()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/main/main.cpp#L4923) or exclude GPU wait operations
2. Add separate performance monitors ([`set_process_time`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8a/main/performance.cpp#L535) could be split into `TIME_PROCESS_CPU` and `TIME_PROCESS_GPU_WAIT`) to distinguish CPU work from GPU synchronization
Yeah, this has bothered me for a while – I'll have a look at it to see what options make sense.
